question: Where did Mangal Pandey refuse to use the greased cartridge?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barrackpore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__The Revolt of 1857__

__
 
• The 19th Infantry at Berhampur (Barrackpore), refused to use the newly introduced Enfield rifle.
 
• The infantry was disbanded.
 
• Mangal Pandey, a sepoy of the 34th Native Infantry at Barrackpore attacked and fired at his British Officers.
 
• Mangal Pandey was born on 19 July 1827.
 
• Mangal Pandey was an Indian soldier who took part in the revolt of 1857.
 
• He belongs to the 34th Bengal Native Infantry regiment.__
 
• One of the major incidents that took place in this revolt was that he killed two British officers Hugeson and Baugh at Barrackpore.
 
• He died on April 8 and his regiment was banned on the 6th of May.
 
• A postage stamp was issued on behalf of his name in 1984.
 
• "Shaheed Mangal Pandey Maha Udyan" is a park in Barrackpore.
